name: CHUNITHM Rating
description: Shows your CHUNITHM rating imported into chunirec in the in-game colors (green to rainbow-extreme) with progress to the next color, BEST / NEW frame averages, top BEST-frame charts, the frame border and how many points each candidate needs to enter the BEST frame (derived from the X-VERSE-X formula), with a one-tap button to post the rating. Authenticates the chunirec API access token as a query parameter via Secret Vault.
